regs_in_letter: FD&C Act misbranding (false or misleading); no CFR section cited in letter text

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (open-label extension)
cases.claim: “Proven to help people with ATTR-CM live longer” | “People lived longer with continued treatment” | “The risk of death was lower over 3½ years with AMVUTTRA.*” with graphic “36% Lower Risk compared to placebo” | “80% Survival Rate for people taking AMVUTTRA at 3½ years compared to 72% for people taking placebo” | monotherapy tab: “35% Lower Risk compared to placebo”; “76% Survival Rate for people taking AMVUTTRA at 3½ years compared to 67% for people taking placebo”
cases.context: 3.5-year mortality includes 6-month open-label extension after placebo patients switched; disclaimer 'This analysis was not included in the original study plan...' does not cure. FDA also received complaints about similar pieces.
cases.rationale: No concurrent control remained at 3.5 years; open-label extension cannot support definitive quantified mortality benefit.
cases.check: Are quantified efficacy claims drawn from an open-label extension or period after control-arm crossover presented as controlled comparisons?
